/* * 깃플챗 근무이력 리스트 */ WITH AAA AS ( SELECT A.USER_ID ID, C##RG.DEC_B64(S2.FLNM_ENCPT) NM, S2.NCKN_NM NM2, A.WORK_YMD YMD, B.BGNG_HR AS T10, B.END_HR AS T20, TO_DATE(A.WORK_YMD||B.BGNG_HR,'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') - 1/24 AS T11, --배정시작 - 1시간
CASE WHEN B.BGNG_HR > B.END_HR THEN TO_DATE(A.WORK_YMD||B.END_HR,'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') + 1 ELSE TO_DATE(A.WORK_YMD||B.END_HR,'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') END AS T12, --배정종료시간 CASE WHEN B.BGNG_HR > B.END_HR THEN TO_DATE(A.WORK_YMD||B.END_HR,'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') + 1 + 6/24 ELSE TO_DATE(A.WORK_YMD||B.END_HR,'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') + 6/24 END AS T22 --퇴근검색최대시각
FROM AYC100 A, AYC110 B, SAA200 S1, SCA100 S2 WHERE 1=1 AND S1.USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND S1.ENFSN_NO = S2.ENFSN_NO AND A.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = B.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AND A.USER_ID = #{sUserId} AND A.WORK_YMD BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} )
SELECT NM AS FLNM_ENCPT, CD_MN AS CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM, --구분명 CASE WHEN CD = '00' THEN TXT ELSE TO_CHAR(CHG_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') END ST, CASE WHEN CD = '10' THEN NVL(ROUND((LEAD(CHG_DT) OVER ( ORDER BY ID,CHG_DT ) - CHG_DT) * 24 * 60,0),0) ELSE 0 END CT, --채팅상담 CASE WHEN CD = '15' THEN NVL(ROUND((LEAD(CHG_DT) OVER ( ORDER BY ID,CHG_DT ) - CHG_DT) * 24 * 60,0),0) ELSE 0 END OT, --아웃리치/게시판 CASE WHEN CD = '14' THEN NVL(ROUND((LEAD(CHG_DT) OVER ( ORDER BY ID,CHG_DT ) - CHG_DT) * 24 * 60,0),0) ELSE 0 END AT, --사후관리 CASE WHEN CD = '11' THEN NVL(ROUND((LEAD(CHG_DT) OVER ( ORDER BY ID,CHG_DT ) - CHG_DT) * 24 * 60,0),0) ELSE 0 END RT --휴계시간
FROM ( SELECT ID, YMD, NM, NM2, '00' CD, '근무배정시간' CD_MN, --구분명 T11 CHG_DT, --시간 TO_CHAR(T11,'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') FF, --ORDER BY 항목(화면에는 표시하지 않음) TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(YMD,'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || T10 || '~' || T20 TXT FROM AAA
UNION ALL
SELECT C.ID ID, C.YMD YMD, C.NM NM, C.NM2, A.DSCSN_STTS_SE_CD CD, B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM CD_NM, A.CHG_DT CHG_DT, --시간 TO_CHAR(A.CHG_DT,'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') FF, ' ' TXT FROM AYB202 A, SAC100 B, AAA C WHERE 1= 1 AND B.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'DSCSN_STTS_SE_CD' AND A.DSCSN_STTS_SE_CD = B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AND A.DSCSN_STTS_SE_CD IN ('10','11','14','15') AND A.CNSLTNT_ID = C.ID AND A.CHG_DT BETWEEN C.T11 AND C.T22
UNION ALL
SELECT ID, YMD, MAX(NM) NM, MAX(NM2) NM2 , '99' CD, '근무종료' CD_MN, MAX(CHG_DT) CHG_DT, TO_CHAR(MAX(CHG_DT),'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') FF, ' ' TXT FROM ( SELECT C.ID ID, C.YMD YMD, MAX(C.NM) NM, MAX(C.NM2) NM2, MAX(A.CHG_DT) CHG_DT --시간 FROM AYB202 A, AAA C WHERE 1= 1 AND A.CNSLTNT_ID = C.ID AND A.CHG_DT BETWEEN C.T11 AND C.T22 GROUP BY C.ID, C.YMD
UNION ALL
SELECT C.ID ID, C.YMD YMD, C.NM NM, C.NM2 NM2, NVL(A.LVFFC_DT,C.T12) CHG_DT FROM AYC495 A, AAA C WHERE 1=1 AND A.CONSTT_ID (+) = C.ID
AND A.LVFFC_DT (+) > C.T11 AND A.LVFFC_DT (+) < C.T22
) GROUP BY ID, YMD ) ORDER BY FF
